trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) } AND EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) } RETURN c.city_name AS col1, c.population AS col2, t.founded_year AS col3, c.city_name AS col4, t.team_name AS name_team, c.city_name AS name_city
